messages:
maggie: Quick sync for roadmap blurb — customer asks around flexible tiers keep coming. We need a concise policy: are add-on limits per-tier hard or advisory? Also need launch gates tied to billing and SLAs. Decision before EOD.

jules: Recommend hard caps for public tiers (Basic/Pro/Enterprise) to avoid unexpected infra cost. Advisory limits for Dedicated trials with negotiated add-ons.

marco: From eng: hard caps are easiest to enforce. For negotiated deals, we can implement tenant-level overrides but must surface them in Console and billing CSV.

nina: Sales feedback: enterprise customers expect burst lanes and priority routing add-ons. They want predictable pricing bands (e.g., priority lane = +X% of base). We should publish guardrails so AEs don't undercut margins.

oliver: Ops asks: launch criteria should include billing able to represent list vs effective price, quota enforcement for add-ons, and billing alerts for margin erosion >15% per tenant.

legal-bot: Legal: negotiated overrides require a signed amendment and a recorded approver chain. For add-on removals/price increases, recommend 120d notice for enterprise, 30d for self-serve. I'll draft amendment and a short clause for the product doc.

jules: Also propose an "escape hatch" for critical infra cost spikes: temporary suspension of add-on for new signups with 7d warning. This must be documented and only invoked with exec signoff.

marco: Tech note: we can implement a feature-flagged path for the escape hatch; need telemetry to measure customer impact and an auto-notify flow.

nina: For launch gating: require (1) billing supports prorations & effective/list price export; (2) Console shows tenant overrides and a banner if effective!=list; (3) sales playbook + amendment template ready; (4) legal signoff.

maggie: OK owners: jules -> tier cap policy & escape-hatch runbook, marco -> infra tickets for overrides + telemetry, nina -> sales playbook + AE guardrail cheat sheet, legal-bot -> amendment clause. sales-bot create enablement ticket.

sales-bot: created ticket #9019 "Tier caps, priority lane pricing, and escape-hatch enablement" assignees: jules, marco, nina. ETA 2025-05-12.

maggie: I'll draft the roadmap paragraph with the policy and gates. If no objections, I'll merge the PR at 6pm. Speak now if you want different notice windows or a different margin threshold.

jules: Fine with the windows.

marco: Fine from eng.

nina: LGTM.

legal-bot: No objections; will attach draft clause shortly.
